description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableJsonArray' which represents a JSON array with thread safety, caching, and serialization features. It includes methods for creating, manipulating, and serializing JSON arrays, as well as internal classes for cache management and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of a JSON array supporting caching, serialization, and functional manipulation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.SoftReferencedValueList
classes.description: A cache-oriented internal class managing JSON values with memory-sensitive references, supporting creation from various representations and lazy parsing.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler
classes.description: A thread-unsafe JSON handler for parsing JSON array strings into a List<JsonValue> structure for internal use.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty JSON array.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating an ImmutableJsonArray from a list of JsonValue, with optional known representations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Methods for appending various types of values to the array, returning new ImmutableJsonArray instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific index, wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the array contains no elements.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the array.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific JsonValue is present in the array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given JsonValue.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the array's values.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream<JsonValue> over the array's values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for value equality between two ImmutableJsonArray instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on internal value list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representation of the array.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the array into a provided serialization context.

methods.name: upperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Calculates an estimated upper bound size for the array's string serialization.
